paragraphs.heading: Application details
paragraphs.text: Applicant: Brackenfield Solar Ltd. Landowner: Mr J. Hartley, Bracken Farm.

paragraphs.heading: Description of development
paragraphs.text: Installation of a ground-mounted solar photovoltaic array and battery energy storage system with a maximum export capacity of 49.9MW, together with associated infrastructure.

paragraphs.heading: Location
paragraphs.text: Land at Bracken Farm, Wickham, comprising Parcels 9, 10 and 11.

paragraphs.heading: Decision
paragraphs.text: Wickham District Council hereby grants planning permission for the development described above, subject to the conditions below.

paragraphs.heading: Condition 1: Time limit
paragraphs.text: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

paragraphs.heading: Condition 1: Time limit
paragraphs.text: Reason: To comply with section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.

paragraphs.heading: Condition 2: Approved plans
paragraphs.text: The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans listed in Schedule A.

paragraphs.heading: Condition 2: Approved plans
paragraphs.text: Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

paragraphs.heading: Condition 3: Temporary permission
paragraphs.text: The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period of 40 years from the date of First Export, after which the site shall be restored.

paragraphs.heading: Condition 3: Temporary permission
paragraphs.text: Reason: The development is temporary and the land should be returned to agricultural use.

paragraphs.heading: Condition 4: Decommissioning
paragraphs.text: Within six months of the cessation of export, a scheme for the removal of the development shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.

paragraphs.heading: Condition 4: Decommissioning
paragraphs.text: Reason: To secure the restoration of the site.

paragraphs.heading: Condition 5: Construction traffic
paragraphs.text: No development shall commence until a Construction Traffic Management Plan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

paragraphs.heading: Condition 5: Construction traffic
paragraphs.text: Reason: In the interests of highway safety.
